title: Mode of Grouped Data — Statistics
hook: Let's explore Mode of Grouped Data from the chapter on Statistics. This is an important concept in NCERT Class 10 Mathematics that builds your foundation for higher studies!
explanation:
Mode of Grouped Data Mode = l + [(f₁ − f₀)/(2f₁ − f₀ − f₂)] × h, where the modal class has the highest frequency. Key Ideas to Master:
💡 Modal class = class with the highest frequency
💡 Mode = l + [(f₁ − f₀)/(2f₁ − f₀ − f₂)] × h
💡 f₁ = frequency of modal class, f₀ = frequency before, f₂ = frequency after
💡 Empirical relation: 3 Median = Mode + 2 Mean (approximate)
